description: This file defines the DeviceAuthHandler class responsible for managing device authorization flows in a VSCode extension, including starting, canceling, and disposing of device authentication sessions, and handling related events.

classes.name: DeviceAuthHandler
classes.description: Class that manages device authorization flow, event handling, and resource cleanup for Kilo Code authentication.

methods.name: startDeviceAuth
methods.description: Initiates the device authorization process, sets up event listeners, and handles success or failure scenarios.

methods.name: cancelDeviceAuth
methods.description: Cancels the ongoing device authorization process and cleans up resources.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Disposes of the DeviceAuthService instance and cleans up resources.
